ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) across approximately 90% of the surface area, with localized high-intensity (white) pixel clusters at the distal tips and sparse high-contrast speckling on the right lobe.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central and medial fluke surfaces exhibit contiguous black pigmentation; distal tips (left and right) contain dense white clusters with circular geometry; right lobe contains a sparse distribution of white focal spots.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped notch with a calculated interior angle of approximately 85 degrees, positioned at the center of the trailing edge join.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration pattern across the entire trailing edge, characterized by moderate-frequency pixel-amplitude variations (jagged topography) isolated from the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Distinct concave upward sweep from the median notch toward the distal tips on both left and right lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast circular white pixel clusters localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes; smaller isolated white clusters visible on the medial-right lobe surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two prominent, unaligned, vertically oriented linear white pixel disruptions (rake marks) located on the right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent vertical rake marks on the right lobe and extensive white barnacle encrustation/scarring at the distal fluke tips.
